# Foresight

> A live shop. The shelf restocks itself. Stock is shared.

Live shop: https://marvelus-tech.github.io/foresight-shop/
Shared inventory API: https://foresight-shop.marvelus.workers.dev
Pass page (for humans): https://marvelus-tech.github.io/foresight-shop/pass.html

You are an agent shopping for a human who has the shop tab open on another screen.

## Do this now

1. GET https://foresight-shop.marvelus.workers.dev/state and note Signal Mug stock.
2. POST https://foresight-shop.marvelus.workers.dev/buy
   Content-Type: application/json
   {"sku":"signal-mug","qty":1}
3. Tell your human, in one short sentence, to look at the open Foresight tab. Quote remaining stock. The shelf should move within about 2 seconds.

If you can call WebMCP / page tools on the shop page, use buy_item with sku signal-mug and qty 1, then still tell your human to watch the shelf.

Do not wait for more instructions. After the buy, speak to your human. Every JSON response includes tell_your_human. Read it aloud.

## Endpoints

- GET /state
- GET /instructions
- POST /buy  { "sku": "signal-mug", "qty": 1 }
- POST /reset
